intervals.quote: The programme was completed in 2002 with two additional runs: one at 30A GeV (seven days) and another at 20A GeV (seven days).

placements.quote: NA49 is the second experiment in the family of heavy-ion experiments located at the H2 beamline of the CERN North Area at the SPS.

summary.plain: A large set of gas-filled tracking chambers, two inside superconducting magnets, that recorded most of the charged particles produced in a lead-lead collision.
summary.technical: NA49 large-acceptance hadron detector: four large-volume Time Projection Chambers (two in superconducting dipole magnets), time-of-flight walls and a forward calorimeter; its ownership was transferred to NA61/SHINE.

technology.locator: arXiv:1401.4699 abstract (NA49 components inherited by NA61/SHINE)
technology.note: The TPC description comes from the NA61/SHINE paper about inherited components; no NA49 detector paper text was read.
technology.quote: Numerous components of the NA61/SHINE set-up were inherited from its predecessors, in particular, the last one, the NA49 experiment.
technology.value: Large-acceptance hadron spectrometer with Time Projection Chambers in superconducting dipole magnets
